description: The groups a lead's fields are organised into, and where each group's values are stored.

fields.label: Section Key
fields.description: The short key that names this section, e.g. lab.

fields.label: Title
fields.description: The heading these fields are shown under.

fields.label: Display Order
fields.description: The section's position on the page. A lower number sits higher.

fields.label: Target DocType
fields.description: The record type these fields belong to.

fields.label: Child Table Field
fields.description: The table on the lead holding these rows. Left blank, the section is the lead record itself.

fields.label: Is Multi Row
fields.description: A lead may carry many of these rows - a lab report per date, a treatment cycle per date.

fields.label: Row Key Field
fields.description: The field that identifies one row, such as report date. Required when the section is multi-row.

fields.label: Is Key Value
fields.description: The section stores one row per question rather than one column per question, so a new field can be added without changing the database.

fields.label: Value Field
fields.description: The field holding the answer. Required when Is Key Value is ticked.

fields.label: Label Field
fields.description: The field holding what the answer is called. Required when Is Key Value is ticked.

fields.label: Question Field
fields.description: The field holding the original question key.

name: CRM Lead Section
